title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $600 on Roborock Saros 10R
excerpt: This robot vacuum makes cleaning look effortless.
content_html:
SAVE $600: As of Sept. 21, the Roborock Saros 10R is on sale for $999.99 at Amazon. That's a 38% discount on the list price.

Credit: roborock

$999.99 at Amazon
$1,599.99 Save $600

If you'd happily forget about cleaning your floors, a robot vacuum is a great idea. These handy little machines can keep on top of the everyday dust and dirt that somehow appear out of nowhere. And these days, the best models can even mop your floors, so there's really no effort needed from you at all.

The Roborock Saros 10R is one such model, and it's currently on sale for $600 off the list price. As of Sept. 21, this robot vacuum is down to $999.99, which is also its lowest-ever price.

There's so much going for this vacuum, from its 22,000Pa HyperForce suction to the Zero-Tangling DuoDivide Main Brush and FlexiArm Riser Side Brush that help prevent hair from getting wrapped around the brushes. It's even small enough to pick up hidden dirt under chairs or couches, thanks to its 3.14-inch height.

And the multifunctional dock is its powerhouse. Here, it stores dirt and dust for up to 60 days (so you don't need to constantly empty it), washes and dries the mop pads with hot water and hot air, and then refills the tanks with water and detergent. You can also control cleaning through the Roborock app or use the built-in voice assistant.
